## Classic candy or gourmet treats for your 2026 Halloween party? The answer is both


Planning any kind of party can be difficult, but a Halloween party? It has an extra layer because people crave their beloved trick-or-treat candy. But we’ve come a long way from candy corn and KitKats. Today’s elevated Halloween treats, think Halloween cupcakes, themed brownies, pumpkin-spiced baked goods, bring sophistication to those craving the most fun flavors. Luckily, you can satisfy everyone. Both nostalgic snacks and gourmet treats can have a place at your Halloween buffet.


### **A combination of nostalgic treats and gourmet desserts brings a wow-factor to your Halloween soiree**


Here’s the problem, though. Nobody wants to buy Halloween candy and then spend another few hours baking to get fancy cakes and cupcakes. Americans are projected to spend a record **$3.9 billion on Halloween candy** in 2026 (part of a record $13.1 billion in total Halloween spending, per the National Retail Federation) — but gourmet treats bought online and delivered to your home are a fast-growing category of that spend. So why not have both the nostalgic candy and the fancy treats by putting out bowls of chocolate and candy corn, while having Insta-worthy desserts delivered? It saves you time and satisfies everyone.


## **Trick-or-Treat Classics to Have at Your Party**


### **Chocolate Bars**


Choose fun size, or get full size if you want to embody the awesome neighborhood house. Some favorites for kids and adults everywhere: Snickers, KitKat, Milky Way, Hershey Bars.


### **Candy Corn & Nostalgic Hard Candies**


You never really forget your first taste of candy corn — it’s a pretty polarizing treat! Pair it with nostalgic hard candies like Werther’s Original, Jolly Ranchers, and strawberry bonbons.


### **Lollipops, Gummies, and Taffy**


How many licks does it take to get to the middle of a Tootsie Pop? You’ll find out at your party when you fill a bowl with those, gummies and fruit snacks, and saltwater taffy.


## **Gourmet Treats to Get Delivered**


### **Halloween-Themed Cakes & Cupcakes**


From cupcake towers to piles of decorated cookies, your party table will be extra spooky with a Halloween aesthetic. Wow the kids (and adults!) with a Halloween Spooky Sprinkle Surprise Cake — it’s a real grammable slice.


### **Specialty Brownies & Cookies**


Orange and black, the colors of the season, swirl together in a Halloween Oreo Brownie + Cookie Combo, or in any other spooky season styled pies and cheesecakes. Or, what about brownies designed to look like eyeballs?


### **Pumpkin Spice Creations & Seasonal Desserts**


Spooky time is pumpkin spice time, so drop those seasonal spiced desserts into your online shopping cart. Enjoy apple cider flavors too, like a Fall Shortbread sampler.


## **Spooky Snacks FAQs**


**** **What are classic trick-or-treat candies?**


Classic Halloween candies are the best of the best from your trick-or-treat bag when you were a kid. Think things like fun-size candy bars and chocolates, candy corn, pumpkin-shaped gummies, popcorn balls, lollipops, and other nostalgic pre-packaged treats.


**** **What are gourmet Halloween treats?**


Gourmet means more unique Halloween treats — essentially things that wouldn’t have fared well in your pillow case trick-or-treat bag. Gourmet treats can be[booze-infused candies](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/halloween-booze-infused) or chocolates; decorated[Halloween cookies](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/halloween-cookies) ,[cupcakes](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/halloween-cupcakes) , **[candy](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/halloween-candy)** and[cakes](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/halloween-cakes) ; and seasonal specialties made by **[high-end bakeries](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/categories/bakeries)** or **[confectioners](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/categories/confectioners)** .


**** **Where can I order gourmet Halloween treats online?**


Halloween treat shopping can be spookily simple. Goldbelly ships gourmet snacks and **[Halloween desserts](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/halloween-desserts)** , nationwide in time for Halloween.


**Should I get classic candy or gourmet treats for my Halloween party?**


Both, if you can — they serve different purposes. Classic candy is the budget-friendly, universally loved option for trick-or-treaters and a candy bowl. Gourmet treats are the centerpiece that makes a party feel like an event. Most hosts do best combining the two rather than choosing.
